rows.event: Walk-in Interview (Senior Teaching Associate & Teaching Associate)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Pune?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview dates are staggered. For Senior Teaching Associate & Teaching Associate, it is on 31st August 2026. For Administrative Assistant, it is on 2nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by IISER Pune?
faq.answer: IISER Pune has released a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Senior Teaching Associate, Teaching Associate, and Administrative Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Administrative Assistant post, a Bachelor's degree in Administration or Commerce or Management with a minimum of 50% marks or equivalent grade is required, along with at least 1 year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. How will the selection be done for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Senior Teaching Associate position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Senior Teaching Associate position ranges from Rs. 50,000/- to Rs. 55,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is IISER Pune located?
faq.answer: IISER Pune is located in Pune, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for these positions?
faq.answer: No, these positions are being filled through a Walk-in Interview, and online applications are not accepted.
